audit.why: Bouncing Bomb 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 at 850; Satchel Charge 20/18/16/14/12 at 1000; Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s at 900; Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70 at 5000.
audit.corrected: Names and numbers written through the cooldowns field, the dos bullets, the phase whys and the spikes — Satchel's 20s at rank 1 is now the stated window.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] said Ziggs shoves "with W Satchel" and wants.foe[0] called the minefield his W. The minefield is Hexplosive Minefield (E); Satchel Charge is the W. The page also never mentioned Short Fuse.
audit.why: Riot text: Satchel Charge "flings an explosive charge... knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage" — it is a knockback that repositions Ziggs himself. Hexplosive Minefield "scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact", and successive detonations on the same target deal reduced damage. Short Fuse periodically empowers his next basic attack, and its cooldown drops whenever he casts.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected, the self-displacement stated, and the Short Fuse wind-up added as the trade tell.

notes: Slot error fixed in two places: the minefield is Hexplosive Minefield (E), not the W — spikes[0] had Ziggs shoving 'with W Satchel' and wants.foe[0] called the minefield his W. Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 (the page said fifteen) and Riot's text notes it displaces Ziggs himself, which is what makes him catchable only on its downtime. Short Fuse's empowered auto is now on the page as the trade tell.
